answer: A concrete defense is a quadratic entry bond keyed to each funding source. Every agent must lock scarce capital before it can trade or vote, and the required stake rises with the square of how many keys draw from one wallet inlet. An honest operator funds a single key and posts only a small delta of collateral; a sybil operator flooding a hundred clones through one source owes ten thousand units. Any whisper of coordinated cheating is spot-checked and slashes the whole bond, so faking many identities costs far more than the clones can ever earn.
